Ein Lieferant möchte auf die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit zurückgreifen (wie im Königlichen Erlass vom 18. Juni 2017, Artikel 72§1, vorgesehen). Ein Lieferant kann einen Qualifizierungsantrag stellen und für die Qualifizierungskriterien, die Anforderungen in Bezug auf die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle oder technische Leistungsfähigkeit sowie berufliche Befähigung enthalten (3.3.2 und 3.3.3), die Kapazitäten anderer Wirtschaftseinheiten in Anspruch nehmen. Mit anderer Wirtschaftseinheit ist eine andere (natürliche oder juristische) Person als der Lieferant selbst gemeint. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so gibt er dies in der Frage in Teil II C der EEE an. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so muss er zusätzlich zu einer EEE diese Wirtschaftseinheit veranlassen, den Abschnitt „Leistungsfähigkeit Dritter“ in Anhang 3 auszufüllen. Ohne diese Anlage kann der Lieferant eine solche Leistungsfähigkeit nicht in Anspruch nehmen. Unter Punkt 2 des Fragebogens in Anlage 1 muss angegeben werden, für welchen Teil des Auftrags diese Leistungsfähigkeit in Anspruch genommen wird. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. DESCRIPTION OF THE CONTRACT BEING PROCURED 1.1 NAME OF CONTRACT AND SUMMARY OF SERVICES/GOODS REQUIRED/SUMMARY OF REQUIREMENTS This is a call to competition by TII for the procurement of external members (“External Members”) of the MetroLink Programme Steering Committee 2, a TII governance entity established to support the governance, oversight and delivery of MetroLink (the “Contract”). MetroLink is a transformative piece of new public transport infrastructure, the first of its kind in Ireland. It will comprise a high-capacity, high-frequency, modern and efficient metro railway, with 16 new stations running from Swords to Charlemont. The alignment will link Dublin Airport, Irish Rail, DART, Dublin Bus and Luas services and create a fully integrated public

deliverables_scope.text: arrangements which provide clarity on roles and responsibilities, accountability and the framework for effective and efficient decision -making and oversight. The MetroLink Programme Steering Committee is established as part of TII and is accountable to the TII Board. The MetroLink Programme Steering Committee is a governance function and the main decision - making body on functions delegated to it by the TII Board (within delegated authority thresholds) or NTA (if applicable). The purpose of the MetroLink Programme Steering Committee is to: guide the MetroLink programme through phased development in accordance with applicable requirements and policies with a focus on health & safety, programme, risk management, financial oversight, scope changes and compliance with approvals as issued ; Oversee the development and delivery of MetroLink programme; and to provide executive oversight and challenge of the programme’s execution and to be the decision -making body on key matters related to MetroLink not reserved for the Approving Authority, Government or TII Board. Risk Oversight • Overseeing effective risk identification, management and mitigation strategies are in place to proactively address potential challenges and issues. • Overseeing contingency plans to address potential issues. • Overseeing escalation of risk. rseeing escalation of risk. Quality Assurance • Promoting a culture of quality and excellence throughout the programme lifecycle. Safety and Sustainability • Promoting a culture of health, safety, sustainability, and innovation throughout the programme lifecycle. • Oversight of programme activities and compliance with relevant health, safety, and environmental regulations and standards. • Overseeing the approach taken relating to sustainable practices and technologies used to minimise the programme's environmental impact. Financial Oversight • Overseeing the programme's financial management. • Reviewing and approving budget changes and contingency drawdown within delegated authorisations. • Monitoring programme expenditures and oversight of financial reporting. • Approval of key documents and reviewing contractual issues and disputers and making supporting decisions around these (e.g. entering/terminating contracts, etc.) • Overseeing cost control measures, contingency management and compliance with financial control procedures and financial governance practices. • Overseeing, reviewing and supporting funding requests to Government stakeholders to support delivery of the programme. • Overseeing that financial resources are used economically

The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. April 2022 nicht an Personen oder Unternehmen vergeben werden, die einen Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vor- schrift aufweisen. Dies umfasst sowohl unmittelbar als Bewerber, Bieter oder Auftragnehmer auftretende Per- sonen oder Unternehmen als auch mittelbar, mit mehr als zehn Prozent, gemessen am Auftragswert, beteiligte Unterauftragnehmer, Lieferanten oder Eignungsverleiher. Ein Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift besteht a) durch die russische Staatsangehörigkeit des Bewerbers/Bieters oder die Niederlassung des Be- werbers/Bieters in Russland, b) durch die Beteiligung einer natürlichen Person oder eines Unternehmens, auf die eines der Kriterien nach Buchstabe a zutrifft, am Bewerber/Bieter über das Halten von Anteilen im Umfang von mehr als 50 Prozent, c) durch das Handeln der Bewerber/Bieter im Namen oder auf Anweisung von Personen oder Unter- nehmen, auf die die Kriterien der Buchstaben a) und/oder b) zutreffen. Bereits vor dem 9. April 2022 geschlossene Verträge mit solchen Personen oder Unternehmen mit Bezug zu Russland dürfen nur bis zum 10. Oktober 2022 fortgeführt werden. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so gibt er dies in der Frage in Teil II C der EEE an. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. DESCRIPTION OF THE CONTRACT BEING PROCURED 1.1 NAME OF CONTRACT AND SUMMARY OF SERVICES/GOODS REQUIRED/SUMMARY OF REQUIREMENTS This is a call to competition by TII for the procurement of external members (“External Members”) of the MetroLink Programme Steering Committee 2, a TII governance entity established to support the governance, oversight and delivery of MetroLink (the “Contract”). MetroLink is a transformative piece of new public transport infrastructure, the first of its kind in Ireland. It will comprise a high-capacity, high-frequency, modern and efficient metro railway, with 16 new stations running from Swords to Charlemont. The alignment will link Dublin Airport, Irish Rail, DART, Dublin Bus and Luas services and create a fully integrated public

deliverables_scope.text: arrangements which provide clarity on roles and responsibilities, accountability and the framework for effective and efficient decision -making and oversight. The MetroLink Programme Steering Committee is established as part of TII and is accountable to the TII Board. The MetroLink Programme Steering Committee is a governance function and the main decision - making body on functions delegated to it by the TII Board (within delegated authority thresholds) or NTA (if applicable). The purpose of the MetroLink Programme Steering Committee is to: guide the MetroLink programme through phased development in accordance with applicable requirements and policies with a focus on health & safety, programme, risk management, financial oversight, scope changes and compliance with approvals as issued ; Oversee the development and delivery of MetroLink programme; and to provide executive oversight and challenge of the programme’s execution and to be the decision -making body on key matters related to MetroLink not reserved for the Approving Authority, Government or TII Board. Risk Oversight • Overseeing effective risk identification, management and mitigation strategies are in place to proactively address potential challenges and issues. • Overseeing contingency plans to address potential issues. • Overseeing escalation of risk. rseeing escalation of risk. Quality Assurance • Promoting a culture of quality and excellence throughout the programme lifecycle. Safety and Sustainability • Promoting a culture of health, safety, sustainability, and innovation throughout the programme lifecycle. • Oversight of programme activities and compliance with relevant health, safety, and environmental regulations and standards. • Overseeing the approach taken relating to sustainable practices and technologies used to minimise the programme's environmental impact. Financial Oversight • Overseeing the programme's financial management. • Reviewing and approving budget changes and contingency drawdown within delegated authorisations. • Monitoring programme expenditures and oversight of financial reporting. • Approval of key documents and reviewing contractual issues and disputers and making supporting decisions around these (e.g. entering/terminating contracts, etc.) • Overseeing cost control measures, contingency management and compliance with financial control procedures and financial governance practices. • Overseeing, reviewing and supporting funding requests to Government stakeholders to support delivery of the programme. • Overseeing that financial resources are used economically

The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. April 2022 nicht an Personen oder Unternehmen vergeben werden, die einen Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vor- schrift aufweisen. Dies umfasst sowohl unmittelbar als Bewerber, Bieter oder Auftragnehmer auftretende Per- sonen oder Unternehmen als auch mittelbar, mit mehr als zehn Prozent, gemessen am Auftragswert, beteiligte Unterauftragnehmer, Lieferanten oder Eignungsverleiher. Ein Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift besteht a) durch die russische Staatsangehörigkeit des Bewerbers/Bieters oder die Niederlassung des Be- werbers/Bieters in Russland, b) durch die Beteiligung einer natürlichen Person oder eines Unternehmens, auf die eines der Kriterien nach Buchstabe a zutrifft, am Bewerber/Bieter über das Halten von Anteilen im Umfang von mehr als 50 Prozent, c) durch das Handeln der Bewerber/Bieter im Namen oder auf Anweisung von Personen oder Unter- nehmen, auf die die Kriterien der Buchstaben a) und/oder b) zutreffen. Bereits vor dem 9. April 2022 geschlossene Verträge mit solchen Personen oder Unternehmen mit Bezug zu Russland dürfen nur bis zum 10. Oktober 2022 fortgeführt werden.
